abstract: OBJECTIVE: As complete hydatidiform moles (CMs) have been studied less with respect to aneuploidy and its clinical implications, the significance of cytometric aneuploidy in CMs was evaluated. METHODS: Two hundred thirty-nine CMs were studied clinicopathologically and analyzed by flow cytometry using formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues. RESULTS: Of 239 CMs, 182 were diploid, 30 were tetraploid, and 27 were aneuploid (nontriploid/tetraploid aneuploid). There were no significant histologic differences among the diploid, tetraploid, and aneuploid CMs. Persistent disease developed in 20 of 114 CMs (17.6%) (16 of 77 diploid, 4 of 18 tetraploid, and none of 19 aneuploid CMs). Eight diploid and three tetraploid CMs were invasive, and one patient each with diploid CM and tetraploid CM developed choriocarcinoma and none of 19 patients with aneuploid CMs had sequelae. CONCLUSION: These results suggest that aneuploid CMs are associated with less risk for persistent disease than diploid or tetraploid CMs. DNA ploidy status may be an independent predictor of persistent disease.
abstract_ja: 目的:完全胞状奇胎(CM)における異数性とその臨床的意義はこれまで研究が少ないため、CMにおける細胞計測的異数性の意義を評価した。方法:239例のCMを臨床病理学的に検討し、ホルマリン固定パラフィン包埋組織を用いてフローサイトメトリーで解析した。結果:239例のうち182例は二倍体、30例は四倍体、27例は異数性(非三倍体・非四倍体の異数体)であった。二倍体、四倍体、異数体のCM間で組織学的な有意差は認められなかった。114例のCMのうち20例(17.6%)に持続性疾患が生じた(二倍体16/77例、四倍体4/18例、異数体0/19例)。二倍体CM 8例と四倍体CM 3例は侵入奇胎であり、二倍体CMと四倍体CMの各1例で絨毛癌が発症した。異数体CM 19例では続発症は認められなかった。結論:異数体CMは二倍体または四倍体CMより持続性疾患のリスクが低いことが示唆される。DNA倍数性の状態は、持続性疾患の独立した予測因子となりうる。
